$comment: Classification of every Angular template that owns an in-place disclosure (guideline rule ADM-17,
enforced: every aria-expanded element in the file renders <app-disclosure-marker>.
documented: a recorded divergence. kind is one of popup-trigger (overlay menu/popover/dialog, a
different grammar), tree-chevron (navigation tree, chapter 08 owns the chevron), or staged-adoption
(covered by the rule, not yet migrated). A template in neither list fails the check.

src/app/app.html.reason: Studio tab overflow: aria-haspopup="menu" trigger that opens an overlay menu, not an in-place body. Menu grammar, see chapter 02.

src/app/components/cli-model-selector/cl.reason: Model picker trigger. The list opens as an overlay popover anchored to the control; the value chip is the affordance.

src/app/components/concept-help/concept-.reason: Help popover trigger. The content floats over the surface instead of expanding the row.

src/app/components/info-button/info-butt.reason: Info popover trigger. The question-mark glyph is the affordance; the body is an overlay.

src/app/components/markdown-rich-editor/.reason: Editor view-options menu trigger (overlay menu, icon affordance).

src/app/components/model-migration-badge.reason: aria-haspopup badge that opens a migration popover over the surface.

src/app/components/pane-tabs/pane-tabs.c.reason: Tab-strip overflow menu (aria-haspopup="menu"), overlay list of hidden tabs.

src/app/components/tree-row/tree-row.com.reason: Canonical navigation tree row. Its chevron is owned by the Navigation citizenship contract (chapter 08); one marker there would fight the nav rhythm and the active-item bar.

src/app/features/board/components/decisi.reason: In-place disclosure that ADM-17 covers. AGT-2813 converted the reported surfaces only; adoption stays incremental per the chapter 05 contract. Adopt <app-disclosure-marker> and move this file to "enforced" the next time the surface is touched.
